reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intensive Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text:
Very nice mask for oily skin.
It is my second time to buy it. The essence feel like creamy milk. But it’s absorbed so fast and don’t make your face too sticky. Love you so much and I will purchase it again.
reviews.zh:
油性肌用嘅話係一款好好嘅面膜。
已經係第二次回購。精華感覺好似 creamy 嘅牛奶，但吸收得好快，唔會令塊面太黐立。好鍾意，一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intensive Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Wonderful sheet mask, very moisturizing and help tighten the pores. I saved the remaining serum in an empty bottle and it lasted for 2 more applications
reviews.zh: 非常好用嘅片裝面膜，非常保濕，仲有助收毛孔。我將剩低嘅精華液倒入空樽保存，再用多咗兩次。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intensive Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I've been using SOME BY MI retinol for a while now and I really like it! It's a great entry point to retinols. I decided to give the mask a try and I was very pleased! It's very moisturizing and feels amazing on the skin. I will probably buy more of these!
reviews.zh: 我用 SOME BY MI 嘅 retinol 系列已經用咗一段時間，真係好鍾意！係入門 retinol 嘅好選擇。之後決定試吓佢哋嘅面膜，用完非常滿意！保濕度十足，搽上面感覺好好。大機會會再回購！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intensive Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: וואו איזה מסכה סופחת שומנים נדירה כמה אני יפה אלה שאין לכם נוסע ממליצה לכולם אתם לא תתחרטו כי אני עפה עליו ברמות קשות וגם נתתי לחברה שלי היא מתה על זה
reviews.zh: 哇，呢款控油面膜真係超正，仲未買嘅人實在太可惜。推薦畀所有人，唔會後悔，我自己已經愛到不得了，仲推介咗畀我朋友，佢都愛到暈。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intensive Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I got this because I love the retinol serum. But the product left residue that was pilling after. Maybe more suitable during winter.
reviews.zh: 因為鍾意佢哋嘅 retinol 精華所以先買呢款，但用完之後會留低殘留物仲會搓泥。可能秋冬先啱用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intensive Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Really nice mask, I use this mask once or twice a week end my skin really fill healthier. I tried already a few mask from a different brand and this one is one of my favourite.
reviews.zh: 非常好用嘅面膜，我每個禮拜用一至兩次，皮膚真係健康咗好多。之前已經試過其他牌子幾款面膜，呢款係我最鍾意嘅之一。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intensive Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I usually buy these sheet masks for my dad and he always tells me how he loves the results and simplicity of it. He also always asks me to buy him more of these whenever I place an order.
reviews.zh: 平時我買呢啲片裝面膜俾我爸爸用，佢成日同我講話效果好好又夠簡單。每次落單佢都會叫我幫佢多買幾片。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intensive Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I have normal skin, I have high tolerance on active ingredients, and I am at times dehydrated, and I wear a pea size retinol every night. So, my skin lobed this mask. I bought the one to see if I like it to buy the big box and I will definitely will buy it.
reviews.zh: 我係中性肌，對活性成分嘅耐受度高，間中都會有缺水情況，仲每晚用豌豆大小份量嘅 retinol。所以我塊面好鍾意呢款面膜。先買咗一片試吓啱唔啱用，啱嘅話就會入大盒裝，一定會回購。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
